page.overview:
Who is Kryalyn?

Kryalyn is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

Kryalyn is the second-in-command of Aelidas as part of the White Tower's mission against Mazrim Taim when he declares himself to be a False Dragon.
